The '''''Winged Dagger''''' was a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] serving under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Syndor]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] around [[44 ABY]]. That year, command of the ''Winged Dagger'' was given to [[Leeha Faal]], with Syndor as second-in-command. After Faal's [[Death/Legends|death]] while [[beyond shadows]] during the [[mission to the Maw]], however, command of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was given back to Syndor.
